tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral las bdag pho mo dang bcas pa'i gtor mas las rab 'byams sgrub pa bar gcod kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang dpal yon tan bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi chos kun gdod nas nyer zhi yang*// rnam kun stong nyid gar gyi cho 'phrul gyi// bstan pa srung mdzad mthu dbang thob rnams kyis// deng 'dir kun tu dge zhing srungs gyur cig /de'ang chos skyong 'di nyid kyi dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa dang*/ bsnyen pa thems shing drod tshad thob pa'i sngags pa dag gis/ las rab 'byams gang dang ci yang rung ba thams cad gtor ma la brten te sgrub pa'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba nyer bsdogs sta gon du bya ba/ dngos gzhi phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba/ mjug las la sbyar bas don sgrub pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni gnas dur khrod dam gtsug lag khang*/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dben par skyang nul bya zhing*/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi rten spyi dang*/ bye brag chos skyong 'di nyid kyi gtso bo las bdag dang bcas pa'i bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa bshams pa'i mdun du/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong spyi dang*/ 'di nyid kyi gtor ma dkar dmar gyi rgyan dang bcas pa'i mthar sman raka mchod pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya ste/ las gzhung bsrang zhing bsnyen pa kha gso/ bskang ba dang tshogs kyi mchod pa ci mang bya/ gzhan yang dge ba'i dpung bskyed pa'i sāts+tsha/ chu gtor/ gsung sgrog /lam 'phrang bsal ba nye'u 'don pa sogs dkar phyogs ci 'grub sngon du bya ba ni bar gcod mi 'byung zhing las myur du 'grub pa'i gnad du che ba yin no// de nas las mthun gyi dus tshod tshes grangs gza' skar sbyor ba byed pa la bab pa'i tshe/ las mthun gyi stegs bu bcas te/ 'dir drag las gtso bor gyur la zhi sogs zhor sgrub yin pas/ g.yul 'gyed phung shul sogs drag las rtsub pa'i sa las byas pa'i stegs bu rgya dpangs gnas khang dang bstun pa'i ngos/ dug khrag gis byugs pa'i steng du 'bru nag gi chos 'byung khru gang ba'i nang du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod/

de'i steng du mañdzi sogs khri'u khar lcags slang nag po'i steng du/ sran ma bra nag sogs drag po'i 'bru sna rjen btags kyi phye ma/ khrag chen su ra dug chus sbrus pa'i drag po'i bshos bu khru gang pa sbra nag gi dbyibs lta bu sgab bcad/ logs gsum dug khrag gi rgyun lam gsum gsum can gyi nang du dug shog la dug khrag gis bris/ oṃmahākālākālarūpa.ākar+ṣayadzadzaḥshashogaheranishog /heramathumarilashogaderashog /'dirashog 'dirathum/ 'dirathum/ tsit+tabaṃ/ tsit+tarbad/ mahākālāyatoyaphaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar las gang sgrub kyi sham bu btags pa bris te dril/ tshon skud kyis bcings la bcug /de bzhin du gtso bo'i g.yon du srin mo'i gtor ma'i nang du/ trakarak+shashatahritrakarak+sharak+mo/ zhes dang sham bu/ rgyab tu zor ba can gyi gtor ma'i nang du/ oṃmahākālīdun+tiṃrak+mokhalamahidzaḥ zhes dang sham bu/ g.yas su bal mo'i gtor ma'i nang du/ munarak+shadzamunakhabyarbadatrakarak+shakhathuṃkhathuṃrbadarbadadzadzaḥ zhes dang sham bu/ mdun du nag po stobs chen gyi gtor ma'i nang du/ mahākālāyatoyaphaṭayatoyakhug /nikatayanikataya/ bhedzebhedze/ saṃbhedzesaṃbhedze/ zhes dang sham bu/ de ltar phyogs bzhi'i 'khor rnams gru gsum thog mde'u lta bu gtso bo'i sum char slebs pa re bya'o// nag po stobs chen gyi gtor ma'i nang du las bdag pho mo'i gtor ma gru gsum phur bu'i dbal lta bu 'khor snga ma bzhi las cung zad bongs thung ba gnyis kyi nang du/ trakarak+shaya snyingakhalarak+shayadun+tiṃrbadadunabaṃdzadzaḥ zhes dang sham bu btags pa bcug /gtso bo de dag la dug dang khrag dang ro sol chang dang sbyar bas dmar nag tu byugs/ de thams cad dkar dmar gyi rgyan dang drag po'i rtsang*/ mtshe yungs sogs kyis legs par brgyan/ gtor ma de rnams kyi phyi skor du ong skyu bcad kha phyir bstan pa khrag gis sbags pa dang*/ sha dum la sogs pa grangs mang bas bskor zhing thams cad kyang dmar zing nge ba brjid rngam dang ldan pa byas pa'i gtor ma so so'i steng du rang rang gi bris sku dang*/

gtso bo'i steng du mda' rgod sgro mar btags pa'i dar nag gi cod pan me long gis brgyan pa gzugs/ gtor stegs kyi zhol dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du chang gi mchod yon/ sha rus kyi me tog /a mṛ ta'i bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ lha bshos dmar po/ rkang gling dang thod rnga'i rol mo rnams g.yas skor du bshams/ mdun du sman raka g.yab dar nag po la sogs pa nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams de dag gi mdun du lcags snod du/ thun gdan gyi liṅga mtho gang pa la dug khrag gis dgra bgegs gang la bya ba'i gzugs bris pa'i dpral bar rus/ tshigs chen bzhir dzaḥhūm̐baṃhoḥ khar bdudapongalongs/ snying khar dzaḥnṛdzaḥbris pa'i mthar gang la bya ba'i ming rus la dmod sham sbyar ba dang*/ phyi skor dza khram dug khrag gis byugs pa gcer pa'i nang du gdab las kyi nya bo 'bru nag las byas pa mtho gang pa/ skye mched dbang po tshang bar bcas pa'i nang du gang la dmigs pa'i ming rus dmod sham can dang*/ dpral ba kha snying tshigs bzhi rnams kyi gnas yig dang bcas pa dug khrag gis bris pa bcug /dmigs bya yod na de yi dri ma drug dang*/ bgegs yin na gang gnod ngos zin na gnas pa'i sa rdo chu shing ngam/ ngos ma zin na 'dre 'tshub byas pa'i shul gyi sa rdul sogs nya bo dang liṅga gnyis kar byugs pa mgo rang ngos la bstan te steng du zhing lpags sam phung re sogs kyis bkab la bzhag /nye logs su mtshon gri lcags kyi phur bu/ yungs kar/ yungs nag /bra bo/ ram bu/ lcags phye/ zangs phye/ thog lcags kyi phye ma/ mi phyugs bsad pa'i rbab rdo rnams bsres pa sil bur byas pa la/ dug sna/ khrag sna/ sa sna rnams khrag rlon dang sbyar bas ngar btags pa'i thun rdzas gri lcags kyi ral gri rnams 'dzoms par bya/ lha dbye'i rdzas khyi lud ra ru/ mu zi nag po/ gu gul/ rta bon/ yug sa'i zhabs ma/ mdze skra rnams kyang 'dzoms na rab la/

ma 'dzom na gang rnyed kyang bsags/ gzhan yang rnga dung cha lang la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ sgrub pa po rnams stan bde bar gtor ma la kha phyogs par 'dug go// gnyis pa dngos gzhi phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba la'ang gnyis/ stod las byang chub sgrub cing phrin las mngon du bya ba dang*/ smad las drag po'i phrin las dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i rim pa'o// dang po stod las byang chub sgrub cing phrin las mngon du bya ba la'ang gnyis/ bdag lhar gsal ba phrin las gzhung tshags su 'dzud pa nye bar bsnyen pa dang*/ mdun bskyed phrin las bcol ba sgrub pa chen pos khog 'bubs pa'o// dang po bdag lhar gsal bas phrin las rang gzhung tshags su 'dzud pa nye bar bsnyen pa'i rim pa ni// skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas bdag yi dam gang mos su gsal gdab/ bzlas pa byas rjes mchod pa byin rlabs nas bsnyen pa'i bar phrin las rang gzhung ji lta bar bsrang la bsnyen mtshams su/ gtso bo'i nye snying dang*/ sha shog gi bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzla ba ni gal che'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ phrin las sgrub pa chen po'i khog 'bubs pa ni/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas mdun gyi gtor ma la dmigs nas/ phaṭaḥ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi gtor mdos la phog pas gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ de'i ngang las mdun du sra brtan rdo rje'i brag ri nag po rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba'i steng du/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi nag cing rtsub pa 'jigs su rung ba/ phyogs thams cad du me rlung dmar nag rab tu 'bar zhing 'phyo ba/ 'ur sgra thug chom gyi sgra skad drag po 'brug ltar sgrog pa'i nang du/ mi ro dang rta ro gsar rnying mang po gcal du bkram zhing phung por spungs pa/ zhing chen mang po bsregs pa dang*/ mdung gis phug pa dang*/ gsal shing la bskyon pa dang*/

ril po dang*/ phyed pa dang*/ 'thor ba dang*/ gsar pa dang*/ bam zhing rul myags su gyur pas rnam par gang ba/ seng ge nag po dang*/ stag gzig /dom dred/ ce spyang la sogs pa ma rungs pa'i tshogs ngar zhing gdug pa'i nga ro sgrog pa/ khyung dang*/ dur bya kaṅga/ bya rog /khra glag sogs 'dab chags gdug pa can mang po lding ba dang*/ 'bab pa dang*/ gshag pa dang*/ sbrel ba sogs rnam 'gyur du ma dang drag po'i nga ro 'byin pa/ ro langs dang*/ sha za/ 'byung po/ phra men/ sde brgyad dpag tu med pa rnams sha khrag dri tshor ba tsam gyis gar byed pa dang*/ rgyug 'dral hab sha 'gyed cing dgra bgegs zhing bcu mthong ma thag /ha ha dang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang*/ phaṭa phaṭa/ sod sod/ rgyob rgyob kyi sgra skad drag po 'byin zhing rgyug pa/ gzhan yang lha klu phyogs skyong zhing skyong rnal 'byor pa mchod rten dang*/ ri shing chu sprin me rlung sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba/ steng na chu 'dzin dmar nag g.yo zhing 'khrugs pa'i klong nas glog gi zhags pa mtha' yas 'khyug cing*/ 'brug gi sgra skad drag po mang du bsgrags pas stong gsum 'dar zhing g.yo bar nus pa/ rdo rje me'i ser ba dang gnam lcags kyi me mang po phyogs kun tu 'bab pas 'jigs par byed pa/ dur khrod chen po de mthong zhing thos pa tsam gyis kyang skyi g.ya' zhing ma rungs pa byed pa de lta bu'i dbus su keng rus kyi brag nag po mtho zhing yangs pa khrag dang zhag gi mche ris can gyi steng du/ mdung dang ral gri gshib pa'i pho brang mtshon cha rnam lnga skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su/ nṛ tri ti ra baṃ zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs pho mo kha sbub gan rkyal byi chings su bsnol zhing brtsegs pa'i khri'i steng du| raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i yi ge shaṃ nag po las byung ba'i tsan+dan gyi beng chen 'bar ba 'chang gzung la yi ge shaṃ dmar nag gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/

sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ khams gsum sems can thams cad bde la bkod/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad ri rab kyi steng na bzhugs pa'i mgon po'i thugs dam bskul/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po sku mdog dmar nag me ltar 'bar ba/ srin po'i gzugs 'chang rab tu khro 'khrugs rngam pa'i nyams can/ phyag gnyis tsan+dan gyi beng chen 'phyar stabs su bsnams pas lha dmag 'gyed cing bdud dang srin po thams cad brlag par byed pa/ zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba bzhi rnam par gtsigs pa smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom rnams dmar ser me ltar 'bar zhing 'phyo ba/ shangs nas bskal pa'i me rlung 'tshub cing khro gnyer rab tu bsdus te dpral ba'i dbyings su gnyer ma gsum dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa 'bur tshugs bsgrad cing gzigs pa/ zhabs gnyis la bse'i sag chen khra bo yu ring gsol te gyad kyi dor stabs su 'gying ba/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber gser gyi yang thig spras pa gsol ba'i steng du gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing dar nag gis thod bcings pa'i dbus su rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin pū ri dkar po 'chang ba/ thod skam lnga skra mtshams su bcings shing*/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ dug sbrul nag pos ga sha byas pa/ bdag sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa'i bka' nyan gsung sdod byed pa me dpung 'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs shing bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ de'i g.yon du rlung nag 'tshub ma dgu klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus su mgyogs byed rnga mong gwa pa rlung gi gshog pa can gyi steng du bh+yoḥlas sring mo nam mkha' khams kyi dbang mo dbyings phyug ma sku mdog dmar skya ral pa kham nag 'khyil zhing spyan gsum mnga' ba|

ljags 'dril tshems dkar 'grigs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi phreng ba dang g.yon nad rkyal bsnams pa/ sku stod mi lpags kyi slog pa dang smad la re lde khra bo bcings pa/ ma bdud 'bum gyis bskor bar gyur/ rgyab tu pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi gdan du bh+yoḥlas lha mo zor ba can dmar mo g.yas zor ba dang g.yon zhags pa dmar po 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra gzeng ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa lha bdud stong gis bskor bar gyur/ g.yas su pad nyi ro'i gdan la maṃ las bal mo nag mo g.yas mchog phur dang*/ g.yon phu dung thogs pa/ gcer mo skra grol phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa ma mo bye bas bskor bar gyur/ mdun du hūm̐ las bka' sdod nag po stobs chen sku la dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon zhags pa nag po thogs pa/ bdud rta nag po la bcibs shing sngon du lcags kyi bya khra brgyad lding ba/ phyi la stag gzig khyi nag brgyad 'brangs pa/ g.yas na lcags spyang sngon mo brgyad dang*/ g.yon na zangs kyi 'phar ba brgyad 'phyo ba/ bdud rol pa skya brgyad dang ya bdud bye ba dung phyur gyi dmag gis bskor bar gyur/ de rnams kyi 'khor du las kyi mgon po gcer bu mdog nag beng dang ru mtshon gri gug dang thod khrag thogs pa'i tshogs dang*/ las kyi gshin rje nag cing gel ba ri rab dang thod khrag thogs pa'i tshogs dang*/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i srog bdud 'bum dang*/ rno mgyogs kyi pho nya gnod sbyin seng mgo/ tsit+ta sngags rgod/ shan pa lag dmar la sogs pa dang*/ snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad pho mo klu rgyud gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'khor tshogs ri rab kyi rdul snyed kyi grangs las 'das pas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ de dag gi mdun du yi ge tri dmar nag gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ las bdag gshin rje dmar po yab yum khrag gi mdog ltar dmar zhing rngam pa/

bse'i ral pa las khrag gi char 'bab pa/ nyi zla'i spyan bsgrad cing sen mo rno dbal lcags kyu'i rtse mo la bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ srin po pho mo'i g.yang gzhi sku la gsol ba/ phyag na srin po pho mo'i snying dang nang khrol thogs nas snying khrag zhal du rngub pa/ 'khor las kyi gshin rje bshan pa stong gis bskor bar gyur/ lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ mthing nag /bdag dang lcam dral gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gtsug lag khang gnyan po rnams dang*/ ri rab kyi kha nas legs ldan mgon po beng 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i tshogs skad cig gis spyan drangs bar bsam/ sha chen gyi spos bsregs/ rak+ta rlabs/ rkang gling thod rnga la sogs pa rol mo drag tu sgrog /g.yab dar nag po phyogs kun tu g.yab cing spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dpal ldan mgon po chos skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bstan pa bsrung phyir dgra bgegs bsgral slad du// dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas 'dir// 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /e h+ye hi ma hā kā lā sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs pas char sprin dkrigs pa ltar skad cig la byon par bsam/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje brag chen rab tu gtams pa dang*// mi ro zhing chen rab tu bsnol ba'i steng*// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams// rab tu dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol| |ma hā kā lā traka rak+sha sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs su gsol bas/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du thim nas rnal 'byor pa'i las ma grub bar du brtan par bzhugs par bsam/ par bu'i lag len rnams su 'dir bsnyen pa bya ba bshad pa ltar spro na 'og nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen pa dmigs pa dang gtso 'khor pho mo'i bsnyen pa rnams 'dir byas kyang mi 'gal la 'og tu byas kyang chog

/gzhan ni dkyus ltar yin pas gang bde bya chog /de nas mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ mgon po dam can srung ma'i tshogs// 'bru yi bcud phyung chang mchog 'di// dgra bgegs bsgral phyir mchod pa 'bul// dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā traka rak+sha sa ma ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du rkang pa gnyis pa'i mal du/ sha rus dmar gyi me tog 'di/ zhes dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pe= a mṛ ta sbyar bdug spos 'di| |dhū pe= tshil chen zhun gyi mar me 'di// ā lo ke= mkhris chen chang gi dri chab 'di// gan+dhe= dmar gyis byugs pa'i bshos gtsang 'di// nai wi d+ye= thod rnga rkang gling glu+u dbyangs 'di// shapad= zhes dang*/ hūm̐ */ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la// mdzes sdug gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// bsung ba'i dri dang bda' ba'i ro// 'jam pa'i reg bya la sogs pa// 'bul gyi bcol ba'i las mdzod cig /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā traka rak+sha sa ma ya sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shapad gan+dhe ra sa spar+she pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sman raka ni/ hūm̐ */ lha chen mgon po 'khor bcas la// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar sman// rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i dmar chen sogs// dam rdzas mchod pa 'di la rol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā traka rak+sha sa ma ya sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ gtor ma rnams las gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mgon po bsnyen dus bdud rtsi las sbyor dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu dmigs la/ shrī ma hā kā lā e ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī ma hā kā lā ya ma hā ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ traka rak+sha khā hi/ traka rak+sha thun bh+yo kha hī/ trag rak+sha rbad bh+yo khā hi/ zhes bdun nam/ nyer gcig dang*/ slar yang 'og gi gtso 'khor so so'i bsnyen sngags mthar ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi btags pas kyang 'bul lo// bshags pa ni/

hūm̐ */ phyogs dus kun bzhugs mchog gsum bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro dpal mgon 'khor bcas dgongs// thog med dus nas da lta'i lus 'di'i bar// sdom gsum dang 'gal khas blangs dam ma srung*// sgrub la zhugs kyang bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod g.yel// sgra tshig zur nyams bsnyen sgrub las sbyor 'khrul// dam rdzas mchod gtor rgyu chung phud nyams dang*// 'bag btsog gis gnong chad lhag nyes pa'i skyon// sdig ltung nyes sgrib 'di phyi'i gegs gyur pa'i| |nongs pa gang mchis gnong 'gyod sems kyis ni// de ring bshags so bzod par bzhes nas kyang*// sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ yig brgya brjod/ bstod cing bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i klong dkyil nas// chos nyid yang dag don la sku sprul pa// nyid kyi sku mdog mthing gar bstan pa ni// don dam dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa ni// ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga mtshon pa'i rtags// gdug pa sbrul gyis sku la brgyan pa ni// zhe sdang tshul gyis dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i rtags// khro gnyer smin ma rab tu bskyod pa ni// phrin las drag pos bstan pa srung ba'i rtags// zhal gdangs mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa ni// dgra bgegs lha min sha la rol ba'i rtags// sma ra ag tshom mun ltar 'thib pa ni// srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud pa'i rtags// shangs nas me 'bar dug gi 'tshub ma ni// mi mthun sreg cing nad kyis 'debs pa'i rtags// phyag gnyis tsan+da beng chen bsnams pa ni// log 'dren srin po ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags// smug nag dar gyi 'jol ber gsol ba ni// 'jig rten gsum na 'gran zla bral ba'i rtags// gser ska rin chen sked la bcings pa ni// dam la gnas shing re ba skong ba'i rtags// zhabs gnyis dor stabs brkyang bskum bgrad pa ni// khams gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags// de ltar yon tan brgyad ldan nag po che// khros pa'i cha lugs rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog

/lha yi dmag dpon rnal 'byor kun gyi grogs// rin chen srung ma bstan pa'i bka' srung khyod// lcam dral lhan cig lha yi dmag dang bcas// phyogs skyong rgyal chen lha chen brgyad dang bcas// gnod sbyin 'byung po ma rungs klu dang bcas// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro ma mo sde brgyad bcas// ma lus 'khor bcas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// sangs rgyas bstan srungs rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod// lha min g.yul ngo dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol// ces bstod/ spro na skabs 'dir lhug gsol bya ba ni zur du gsal/ bsnyen dzāpa kyi dmigs pa ni/ mgon po dang nag po stobs chen gyi thugs kar hūm̐/ srin mo zor ba can gyi thugs kar bh+yoḥ bal mo'i thugs kar maṃ/ las bdag pho mo'i thugs kar traka rnams rang rang gi mdog can gyi mthar rang sngags so sos g.yas su bskor ba nyi gdan la gnas pa/ sngags kyi 'od zer rang gi zhal nas ma mgon 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du zhugs/ mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ thugs rgyud dang phrin las bskul/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim/ de'i 'od zer mgon po 'khor bcas kyi lte ba nas thon rang gi lte bar zhugs pas/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags 'khor gyi mthar g.yas su bskor zhing mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba'i kha dog dmar smug tu gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ ma hā kā lā kā la rū pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes nye snying ci 'grub bzlas/ de nas mda' dar g.yab cing*/ sha shog /her ni shog /her ma thuṃ/ ril shog /der shog /'dir shog /'dir thuṃ/ 'dir thuṃ/ tsit+ta baṃ/ tsit+ta rbad/ ces pa'i sngags 'di gtso cher gal che'o// 'khor gyi bsnyen pa bzla ba ni/ traka rak+sha sha ta hri traka rak+sha rak+mo/ zhes sring mo'o// oṃ ma hā kā lī dun+tiṃ rak+mo kha la ma hi dzaḥ zhes zor ba can no// mu na rak+sha dza mu na kha bya rbad/ traka rak+sha kha thuṃ kha thuṃ rbad rbad dza dzaḥ

zhes bal mo'o// ma hā kā lā ya to ya phaṭa ya to ya khug /ni ka ta ya ni ka ta ya/ bhe dze bhe dze/ saṃ bhe dze saṃ bhe dze/ zhes nag po stobs chen no// oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lī ya karma ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'khor thams cad do// traka rak+sha ya snying kha la rak+sha ya/ badz+ra dun+tiṃ rbad rbad dun baṃ dza dzaḥ zhes pa ni las bdag pho mo'i sngags te de rnams kyang ci 'grub bzla ba gal che ste/ bsnyen sgrub ma song ba'i las sbyor ni rang nyid ngal ba don med cing thal na rang nyid brlag par 'gyur ba sogs skyon mang ngo*// de ltar bzlas pa zin nas/ 'debs kha 'bul ba ni/ dmar gtor che chung ji ltar 'tsham pa sha khrag gis brgyan pa brgyad bcas pa'i dang po bhan+dha la sogs par bshams/ sman raka sgron la/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings drag po e yi zhing khams su// mi 'gyur rdo rje brag gi ldebs steng na// dur khrod rab 'jigs rngam pa'i gzhal med khang*// dgra bgegs tshar gcod mtshon cha'i pho brang nas// mi ro rta ro 'bum phrag bsnol ba'i steng*// yab gcig dpal ldan nag po chen po ni// sku mdog mthing nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// rngam brjid stobs ldan gar gyi rnam rol can// phyag gnyis tsan+dan beng chen 'debs pa'i tshul// thod skam dbu brgyan thod rlon do shal can// dug sbrul gdug pa'i mchod phyir thog dang bcas// spyan dmar 'khrugs shing sgyur mdzad 'jigs tshul ston// zhal gyi mche ba rno dkar rab tu gtsigs// dar nag 'jol ber srid gsum zil gyis gnon// gser gyi yang thig che brjid dpa' mtshan can| |gser ska rin chen mdzes pa'i ske rags 'chang*// dbu skra se yan srid rtser 'phyo zhing 'bar// smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'phyo// sag chen khra bo yu ring zhabs la gsol// dor stabs 'gying tshul khams gsum dbang du sdud// ru ta ru ta'i sgra skad drag po yis// ma rungs che btsan rnams kyang dngangs shing 'dar// ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs pa yis| |dgra bgegs nyon mongs tshang tshing bsregs par mdzad// ri rab chen po'i rtse mor rtag bzhugs kyang*// thugs rje'i phrin las 'gro kun khams su 'jug

/bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong drug brgyas bskor// khyod ni dus ngan rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i// so kha srung zhing skyob la 'gran zla bral// de phyir bdag gi mos pas khyed bsten zhing*// sgrub mchod sa sde btsugs pa de ltar lags// de bas bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs la// 'dir gshegs bzhugs nas bdag gi re ba skongs// dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// thugs kyi dam skong bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di bzhes la zer ba'i skabs/ gtor chung gtor chen la stob cing sman rak+ta sgron pa ni 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro| |hūm̐ */ dpal chen khyod kyi thugs dam gyis bskul ba// g.yon na rlung nag dgu klong 'khyil ba'i dbus// nam mkha'i khams kyi dbang mo dbyings phyug ma// sku ni dmar skya zla tshes zhal mnga' zhing*// spyan ni rgyu skar bkram pa ji bzhin la// tshems ni spu gri gtams 'dra dkar la rno// sku stod mi lpags stong gi slog pa gsol// sku smad re lde ser po'i sham thabs can| |phyag g.yas gser phreng rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskul// g.yon pa nad rkyal dgra la nad yams 'bebs// rlung gi gshog ldan rnga mo gwa pa zhon// ma mo 'bum gyi dbus nas rol zhing 'gying*// bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam gcig ma// 'dir gshegs bzhugs nas bdag gi re ba skongs// dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// thugs kyi dam skong bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐ */ rgyab tu pad nyi dgra bgegs gdan steng na// rab tu 'jigs pa'i lha mo zor ba can// dmar mo g.yas na zor bas dgra srog gcod// g.yon pa zhags pa dmar pos dgra bgegs 'ching*// gcer mo skra brdzes phyag rgya lnga dang ldan// g.yon brkyang gar bzhugs lha bdud tshogs kyis bskor// 'dir gshegs bzhugs nas bdag gi re ba skongs// dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol| |thugs kyi dam skong bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/

hūm̐ */ g.yas na pad+ma nyi ma ro yi steng*// bal mo nag mo 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can// g.yas pa mchog phur g.yon pa phu dung 'dzin| |gcer mo skra skrol phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// g.yon brkyang gar gyis ma mo bye ba'i dbus// rab tu dgyes shing rol pa'i gar dang ldan// 'dir gshegs bzhugs nas bdag gi re ba skongs// dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// thugs kyi dam skong bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐ */ mdun du bka' sdod nag po stobs chen ni// dar nag ber gyon bdud rta nag po zhon// phyag g.yas ral gri zangs yag dgra srog gcod// g.yon pa bdud zhags nag pos dgra bgegs 'dzin// stag gzig khyi brgyad phyi nas 'brangs shing ngar// lcags kyi bya khra brgyad ni sngon la 'phyo// g.yas na lcags spyang sngon mo 'dur zhing ngu*// g.yon na zangs kyi 'phar ba 'phar zhing rgyug /rol pa skya brgyad bdud dmag bye bas bskor// 'dir gshegs bzhugs nas bdag gi re ba skongs// dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol| |thugs kyi dam skong bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐ */ gzhan yang lha chen nag po chen po'i 'khor// las kyi mgon po las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs// srog bdud 'bum dang rno mgyogs pho nya'i tshogs// gnod sbyin seng mgo tsit+ta sngags rgod dang*// shan pa lag dmar snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs// pho mo klu rgyud ma ning gis bsdus pa// 'jig rten dregs pa'i dmag tshogs grangs med rnams/ /'dir gshegs bzhugs nas bdag gi re ba skongs// dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// thugs kyi dam skong bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ hūm̐ */ ma hā kā lā'i las mkhan pho mo gnyis// mdun du 'khod pa las kyi gshin rje ni// dmar po yab yum smug po khrag rul 'dra// bse yi ral pa khrag gi char pa 'bebs// nyi zla'i spyan bsgrad sen mo lcags kyu'i dbyibs// rtse mor bskal pa'i me 'bar dgra bgegs sreg

/srin po pho mo'i g.yang gzhi sku la gsol// srin po pho mo'i don snying nang khrol tshogs// phyag tu bsnams nas snying khrag zhal du rngub// las kyi gshin rje bshan pa stong gis bskor// 'dir gshegs bzhugs nas bdag gi re ba skongs// dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// ces phrin las bcol/ skabs skabs su 'og nas 'byung ba'i thun sngags kyang brgya stong ci 'grub bzlas la thun rdzas dang gri phur rnams la mchil ma ma song bar phu btab cing ngar blud do// tshul de lta bu zhag nyer gcig /'bring bcu bzhi/ tha mas kyang bdun nam/ lnga gsum tsam du sgrub pa ni las rab 'byams bsgrub par tshegs med pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yin no// // ༈ /gnyis pa smad las drag pos dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i rim pa ni/ thog mar mkhyen par gsol zhing dpang gzu dang shags gdab pa ni/ rin po che'i snod du 'bru dang rin po che sna tshogs chang dang bcas pa'i gser skyems bshams la/ kye/ phyogs bcu dus gsum kun tu gshegs bzhugs pa'i// drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma dgongs su gsol// bslu med skyabs gnas sangs rgyas chos tshogs bcas// yi dam zhi khro dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor// dregs pa lha srin yul lha gzhi bdag sogs// dpang gyur gsong por bzhugs rnams snyan gson la// gzu dang dpang mdzod bden rdzun zhal lce chod// bdag ni sems can rnams la phan pa'i blos// so thar ris bdun smon 'jug byang sems gnyis// rig 'dzin sngags kyi rtsa ba yan lag gi// dam tshig sdom mnos legs par srung sems zhing*// spong sems bdag las gzhan gces bskyed rdzogs lam// rtse gcig sgom dang sgrub la gzhol sems kyang*// sdang byed dgra dang bgegs kyi ma ster ro// phar la phan pa'i bsam pa nyer bzhag nas// dngos rgyud gang gis legs par phan btags kyang*// phan lan gnod pas 'jal ba'i khrel med po/

/sdang byed dgra dang bgegs las gzhan su ci/ /bla ma smod dang mtshams med lnga la spyod// yi dam chos skyong srung mar brnyas 'tshol ba'i// zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la chad pa chod// don med sems can yongs la gnod 'tshe ba'i// ma rungs bgegs kyi tshogs la bka' chad phob// bden smra nyes med bdag gi ra mdar sdongs// dpung dang grogs kyi mthu bskyed nus rtsal phyung*// bden rdzun mi phyed nyes la chad mi 'bebs// de 'dra srid na srung ma mngon shes dang*// rdzu 'phrul yod pas ci bgyid gang du 'byin// de phyir nyes can 'di la chad pa phob// ces brjod gser skyems 'bul/ rten dang brten pa bskyed pa ni/ liṅga'i kheb bsal rak+ta bran te/ phaṭaḥ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du e las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i khang sgrom zur gsum bang rim dgu dang ldan pa/ phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ nang na gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ 'og tu 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba/ bar na phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshubs pa/ ngos su nga rgyal gyi brag ri gzengs pa/ snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i bshan pa bye ba sa ya rgyu zhing gsod gcod kyi las la brtson pa/ dgra bgegs gang yang phyin ma thag lha dang phral zhing rang gshed 'bebs pa 'jigs su rung zhing skyi g.ya' ba/ de'i nang nṛ tri las dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs gang gi rnam par shes pa'i rang gzugs sngo zhing rid pa bkrag dang gzi mdangs med pa/ thal skya bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag cing lag g.yas skra 'bal g.yon brang rdu+ung ba kha nas 'o dod 'bod pa skyob pa'i lha dang phral zhing gsod byed bshan pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhig gsal bar gyur par dmigs/ lag gnyis rdor dril dang lcags kyu'i rgyas/ rang dang mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu tho ba thogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs mtho srid pa'i rtse mo/

dma' rgya mtsho'i gting khung sa 'og sa steng srid gsum gar 'dug kyang lcags kyus snying nas zung*/ zhags pas mgrin pa nas khrid/ lcags sgrog gis yan lag sdoms/ dril bus myos su chug /tho bas brla dpung bcag nas skad cig rang dbang med par bkug ste gzugs liṅga la gnyis su med par bstim par gyur par dmigs la/ dgug gzhug drag po nyer gcig nas gsum gyi bar long skabs gal gnad dang bstun la bya zhing slar 'di skad do// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ nga nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ /bka' nyan nag po chen por bcas// thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya sprul// gnod byed dgra bgegs gar gnas kyang*// lcags kyu 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// snying nas zung la khug la shog /zhags pa 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// ske nas khrid la khug la shog /lcags sgrog 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// yan lag sdoms la khug la shog /dril bu 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// myos su chug la khug la shog /tho ba 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis| |brla dpung chog la khug la shog /dgra bgegs gnod byed pho rnams ni// g.yas su bskor zhing gzugs la phob// dgra bgegs gnod byed mo rnams ni// g.yon du bskor zhing gzugs la phob// khug chings sdoms myos rdul du rlogs// nṛ ā kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ shrī ma hā kā lā sha trūṃ a mu kaṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ badz+ra mut+ga ra hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes bcug cing bstim/ lha dang dbye ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dam nyams sdig can dgra bo 'dis// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bshigs// dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad| |dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la bsdos// rnal 'byor bdag la tho 'tsham pa'i// dgra bgegs las ngan sdig can 'di// skyob byed pho nya dang phye la// pho sri 'byung po rnams la sprod// srog lha dang phyes srog bdud sprod// yul lha dang phyes yul 'dre sprod// 'go ba'i lha lnga dang phyes la// srog gcod 'dre lnga dag dang sprod// srung zhing skyob byed lha dang phrol// nyes 'gyod gtong ba'i 'dre dang sprod// traka rak+sha khaṃ khaṃ/

'buṃ 'buṃ/ sha ta te shaka /ces brjod/ do gal che ba yin na lha dbye'i rdzas kyis nya bo dang liṅga la bdug cing dud pa rang dang lha rten la ma phog par bya/ de min na lha dbye'i rdzas gang 'dzoms kyis liṅga la brab bo// de yang skabs don gal che na gong ltar dgug pa'i las la khug rtags ma thon bar dbye bsal gyi las mi bya/ khug rtags thon nas lha dang dbye// lha dbye'i rtags byung na gdab las bya// gtor zlog rim gro spyi yi bran// dus 'dir drag po'i las la yang*// thun dang zor gyi pho nya yis// de ring dgra bgegs sgrol bar bgyi// tsam la cho ga dkyus ltar du bklag pas chog /'gugs dbye'i rtags mthong na de ma thag thun phur rbod gtong gi las bya ba ni/ thun lag tu thogs la| hūm̐ */ nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ /ma hā kā lā nga yi bran// dus 'dir drag po'i las la ya// thun dang zor gyi pho nya yis// de ring dgra bgegs sgrol bar bgyi// yungs kar ye shes lha yi mda'// gang la 'phang kyang bzlog tu med// drag po'i thun gyi gtso bo ste// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// yungs nag bdud dmag bye ba'i mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// rdo thun srin mo sha za'i mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// lcags phye gdug pa gza' yi mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// zangs phye drag po btsan gyi mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// mtshe rgod ma rungs yul 'dre'i mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// dug sna mu stegs gdug pa'i mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// khrag sna ma mo mo rgyud mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// sa sna phung byed 'gong po'i mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// thun rdzas sna tshogs mgon po'i mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// sngags rgod dmod pa sngags 'chang mda'// de ring nyams pa'i srog la ya// bslu med bden stobs bslu ba med// bskyed rim dran 'dzin g.yo ba med// drag sngags dbal la rdugs pa med// thun rdzas mda' la thogs pa med// dgra bgegs las ngan 'gro dbang med// bla srog 'ben la 'chug pa med// dus 'dir gnam lcags lce 'babs ltar// bla srog 'ben la thun rdzas rdeg

hūm̐ bh+yoḥ lha chen dpal 'bar 'jigs pa'i sku// dpa' brjid gtum pa'i chas rnams rdzogs// sku mdog dmar nag 'gyur ba med// ma rig rmongs pa'i bar chad zlog |mche ba rnam bzhi rno dkar gtsigs// bdud bzhi langs pa'i bar chad zlog /spyan gsum 'khrugs shing me ltar 'bar// dug gsum g.yo ba'i bar chad zlog /dbu la thod skam rnam lngas brgyan// dug lnga'i bag chags thams cad zlog /ral pa se yan mkha' la 'phyo// lha yi ltas ngan thams cad zlog /smin ma ag tshom glog ltar 'khyugs| |gza' yi ltas ngan thams cad zlog /dar nag ber chen sprin ltar gtibs// bdud kyi ltas ngan thams cad zlog /tsan+dan beng chen gsor ba'i tshul// lha min ltas ngan thams cad zlog /gser ska rin chen sked la bcings// btsan gyi ltas ngan thams cad zlog /sag chen yu ring zhabs la gsol// ro langs ltas ngan thams cad zlog /yan lag gdug pa sbrul gyis brgyan// klu yi ltas ngan thams cad zlog /dor stabs 'gying tshul gar dang ldan// sa bdag ltas ngan thams cad zlog /mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// rgyal 'gong ltas ngan thams cad zlog /sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs// dregs pa'i ltas ngan thams cad zlog /mi ro rta ro'i gdan la 'gying*// ro langs ltas ngan thams cad zlog /g.yon na yum chen dbyings phyug ma// mo rgyud ltas ngan thams cad zlog /rgyab tu lha mo zor ba can// 'dre srin ltas ngan thams cad zlog /g.yas su bal mo nag mo gnas// byur chags ltas ngan thams cad zlog /mdun du stobs chen bka' sdod rol// pho rgyud ltas ngan thams cad zlog /las bdag gshin rje pho mo yis// gshin rje'i ltas ngan thams cad zlog /'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho yis// mi rung ltas ngan thams cad zlog /hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni// bdag cag rnams la gnod pa yi// lo zla zhag dus spar sme'i skag /gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa ngan// srog lus dbang rlung dgra gshed skag

/sa bdag phyogs ngan mi rung phyogs// rims dang 'go nad dal yams tshogs// mtshon dug rgyal po mu ge dmag |lo nyes rtsa sad ser ba dang*// byad phur rbod gtong mnan sreg 'phang*// gtad dang sel phung bskrad dbye dang*// ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlog |glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog /rgan sri dar sri gzhon sri zlog /nyin gsum ltas ngan byung ba zlog /mtshan gsum rmi ngan byung ba zlog /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zlog /mi mthun nyer 'tshe thams cad zlog /lus kyi nad gdon thams cad zlog / sems kyi zug rngu thams cad zlog /zlog go sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bsgyur ro gnod pa'i bgegs la sgyur// ces dang*/ gzhan yang gang zlog par 'dod pa thams cad dmigs kyis brjod la bzlog par bya'o// gsum pa mjug las la sbyar bas don sgrub pa la gsum/ cis kyang mi bzlog pa'i phyir sreg pa'i las/ mjug sdud mtha' brtul ba'i phyir mnan pa'i las/ rno ngar mthar phyin cing sgab bcad pa'i phyir 'phang ba'i las so| |dang po ni/ cis kyang mi bzlog pa'i phyir sreg pa'i las ni/ lcags slang sogs su dug khrag gis gru gsum bris pa'i steng dug shing gi hom brtsigs/ dug gi gtor ma/ zhun chen/ sha khrag rus pa/ thang khrom rnams 'du bya/ yug sa'i khyim gyi mes thab khung du me sbar la/ phaṭaḥ thab khung me rab tu 'bar ba drag po chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rab tu 'khrugs pa'i klong chen po'i dbus su sra brtan rdo rje'i brag ri nag po rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba'i steng du dur khrod kyi sa gzhi zhes pa nas/ lha min g.yul ngo dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol lo// zhes pa'i bar gtor mdos rgyas pa'i skabs ltar byas la/ thun gdan gyi liṅga la 'gugs dbye thun phur bsgral las mdor bsdus sngags tsam gyis byas la/
